title: Web Summit: Evento gera 2,5 mil M euros para a economia portuguesa em 10 anos (Executive Digest with Lusa, 5 November 2026)
what_it_says: Executive Digest, from Lusa, reports EY's report on Web Summit's ten Lisbon years released at the press conference of 5 November 2026: 2,492 million euros of impact, jobs, taxes, startups and media value.
